title: andromeda glaucophylla f. latifolia
intro: Andromeda glaucophylla f. latifolia, commonly known as the White Mountain Pieris, is a shrub species that belongs to the Ericaceae family. The plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of White Mountain Pieris include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
